capabilities: Display the shortest link path from a central note to the currently open note
Show all descendant notes of the current note hierarchically
Update the map automatically when switching notes or via a manual sync button
Choose which note sits at the center of the vault in settings
extras: The README references example screenshots that are not included in the text; installation is via the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian's graph shows all links at once but doesn't show where the current note sits relative to a chosen central note or which notes are hierarchically below it.
summary: Generates a Map of Content pane that shows the shortest link path from a central note to the open note plus its descendant notes.
